title: How Eco-Friendly Is a Boat Trip in Madeira? An Honest Answer
description: A motor boat trip is not low-impact. What changes the harm is speed, how the boat treats wildlife, what goes in the sea and how many share it. The trade-offs.
heroAlt: A loggerhead turtle at the surface while a small boat waits well back
keywords: how eco-friendly is a boat trip in Madeira
small boat vs catamaran environmental impact

images.prompt: Photo from water level: a loggerhead sea turtle resting at the surface of calm deep blue water in the foreground, its shell just breaking the surface. Far behind it, a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy waits with its engine idling, the cliffs of the south coast beyond in late morning light. True colours, no text.
images.alt: A loggerhead turtle at the surface while a small boat waits well back
